title: Hang a red cup
subtitle: YAM × GPT-6-Astra · high · Real world

clock.method: Constant offset from three gripper-action anchors across 30 minutes; compared original camera frames with logged submission and requested action duration. Opening/late arm trajectories checked for consistency; slow servo ramps and settling make their visible onset less precise. No drift resolvable at this precision. Original entry ISO timestamps are used, not assistant generation-start fields.

anchors.description: First gripper closure around the cup
Release opens the jaws; cup drops at 845.3–845.9 s
Final release transfers the cup to the peg; cup settles visibly at 1984–1985 s

device_map.description: Two YAM arms on a bench; arm_1 is the right observation arm, arm_2 manipulates the red cup. Flange cameras and overhead camera match the session profiles. Static illustration, not live kinematics.

geometry_evidence.note: Same station geometry verified in the recorded read results: arm_1 can_right at y=-0.6096, arm_2 can_left at origin, matching wrist/overhead camera mounts and YAM URDF. Recorded files are evidence only and are never executed.

device_map.highlight_note: Exact device IDs from selected original tool arguments. Cameras embedded in cube_capture helper results are indicated in the observation cards.

opening_context_note: The original task is displayed from output/source frame zero as opening context. Its recorded submission is source 4.181 s; all physical calls, results and observations retain their actual mapped timestamps. No pre-recording motion is invented.

recording_crop.description: Static crop removes 15% from the left and 10% from the right, retaining full height; uniform scaling to the recording panel, without stretching. Requested to reduce empty margins and passing people at the left edge.

events.text: I’ll recover the mug and use a deeper, verified insertion before releasing again.
I’ve regrasped it and will check the handle from a more direct angle before trying again.
The mug is now hanging from the peg and has stayed in place after the gripper withdrew.

elapsed_time.clock: Original camera recording, retained through success report before arm homing

emphasis: Error recovery: initial release fails, cup is recovered and the insertion replanned; an additional unsupported release is detected before the final successful hang.

Active sensing: right arm supplies wrist-camera views; after the unsuccessful load transfer, entry 413 requests a more direct angle and entry 417 moves the right arm, followed by the confirming view at entry 421.
source_review.endpoint: Cup remains hanging after arm_2 withdraws; right-wrist observation and public success report retained. Later arm homing omitted.
source_review.framing: Static horizontal crop: source x=288..1728, full height 1080; 4:3 framing uniformly scaled to the recording panel. Robot arms, cup, rack and all task motions retained.
source_review.motion_method: All successful servo and nested device-write actions protected; asynchronous writes cover requested duration. Camera-clock guard: 1.0 s before and 1.2 s after. First fall and final release reviewed at half-/one-second resolution.
